description: 60V, 2.4mOhm typ RDS(on) @10V, 150A single N-channel power MOSFET

pinout.name: D
pinout.notes: Drain. Also the exposed pad on the package bottom (Pin 5 / exposed pad, electrically Drain).

land_pattern.notes: Body D1 4.70-4.90mm x E1 5.70-5.90mm, overall D 5.15mm x E 6.15mm, lead pitch e=1.27mm BSC. Recommended soldering footprint (from datasheet drawing dims): source/gate lead pads approx 1.0mm x 0.75mm at 1.27mm pitch; exposed drain pad (Pin 5) approx 3.2mm x 4.56mm centered on the package. Exact pad geometry read from the footprint drawing's dimension callouts (1.270, 0.750, 1.000, 0.905, 4.530, 1.530, 4.560, 0.495, 3.200, 1.330, 0.965mm); verify against the vendor land-pattern drawing before finalizing the footprint, since the numeric labels could not be matched one-to-one to specific pad edges from text extraction alone.

layout_notes: Exposed pad (bottom) is electrically Drain (Pin 5); it is not a floating thermal-only pad - it carries the drain current and must be treated as a power node, not tied to a ground/thermal plane directly.

Junction-to-case thermal resistance RthJC = 1.3 C/W (steady state); junction-to-ambient RthJA = 40 C/W when surface-mounted on FR4 with a 650 mm^2, 2 oz Cu pad (Note 2 of the thermal ratings table) - size the drain copper pour accordingly for thermal performance.

Datasheet gives no dedicated 'Layout' section text (power MOSFET datasheet, not a controller IC); layout guidance above is derived from the thermal test-condition footnote and the exposed-pad/pinout assignment, not a vendor layout narrative.
CONFIRMED from ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS table: Total Gate Charge QG(TOT) at VGS=10V, VDS=48V, ID=50A = 52 nC (typ) - matches LCSC attribute and blocks.md figure.
CONFIRMED from ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS table: RDS(on) at VGS=10V, ID=50A = 2.0 mOhm typ / 2.4 mOhm max - matches abbreviated header spec (2.4 mOhm @10V) and blocks.md figure.
